column4: Afwerker means finisher; 'decorator' is a dubious sense and the finisher meaning is listed separately.
Nescient is an obscure near-duplicate of the agnostic meaning and only confuses learners.
The archaic 'Agrarian laws' sense duplicates and confuses the common meaning 'agrarian', which is already listed.
Aker meaning acorn is not a real Dutch meaning (acorn is 'eikel'; 'aker' is an archaic bucket), so it is wrong and obscure.
Kettle is a dubious archaic sense of aker that only confuses learners and overlaps with the bucket meanings.
'Glass' is not a meaning of amaretto; it duplicates the liqueur sense from the glass-of-amaretto usage.
The gloss 'any other hermit' only duplicates the anchorite meaning.
Apenstaart does not mean e-mail address; that is a metonymic misreading of the @ sign, so this meaning does not exist.
'Missionary' is not a real sense of apostolisch, which means apostolic, and the example uses it unnaturally as an adverb.
'Patriarchal' is not a distinct sense of apostolisch and the gloss is misleading, so it is dropped.
A serving of orange juice is just a countable use of the same meaning as orange juice, so it duplicates meaning 2.
The other listed meaning 'attachment' already covers this, and this entry only repeats it with an email focus.
The meaning duplicates 'fleet of vehicles'; both describe the total vehicles, so the extra listing adds nothing.
A book about the avifauna is a minor extension of the main meaning and is a near-duplicate of the other listed meaning.
An instance of axiology duplicates the other meaning, axiology, and is not a distinct sense.
to swim is too close to the other meaning "to bathe"; badderen means to splash or paddle about, and this duplicates the existing sense.
Mischief and rowdyism are near-synonymous senses of one meaning, so this duplicates the other meaning.
Mie goreng and bakmi are the same dish, so this duplicates the other bami meaning.
Banjeren means to stroll or walk about; the meaning 'to boast' does not exist (that would be bluffen or pochen).
It duplicates the other meaning (basic/essential grammar are the same sense); the article 'de' is correct.
'Female employer' duplicates 'female boss', which is already listed.
To produce is not a real meaning of bearbeiden; the archaic sense is obscure and confusing for learners.
To strive is not a real, current meaning of bearbeiden and would only confuse a learner.
Duplicates the other meaning of beboetbaar (punishable by a fine); one entry is enough.
This archaic sense of 'consideration' (act of deliberating) is obscure and mostly confuses learners; the living meanings are covered by the other entry.
It essentially duplicates the business-activity meaning, since both describe activity within a company.
Productivity is not a real meaning of bedrijfsactiviteit; it is a duplicate of the general activity sense.
Able to be restrained is essentially the same meaning as "controllable", so this duplicates the other meaning.
Planting grass on is not a real meaning of begrazen (that would be bezaaien/inzaaien); it is a mistaken, obscure sense that would confuse learners.
Begrijpelijkheid does not mean empathy or understanding of a person (that is begrip), so this meaning is wrong and overlaps with the first one.
The gloss 'bad' is vague and duplicates the 'come off badly' meaning (bekaaid afkomen), so it is dropped.
to hold is not a real meaning of beknijpen (it means to pinch/squeeze or curtail), and it is covered by the other meanings "to pinch" and "to oppress".
Bensjen as a general 'to bless' is not standard and is covered by the grace-saying meaning, so it duplicates the other entry.
'Definable' and 'determinable' are near-synonymous renderings of the same meaning, so this duplicates the other one.
'To run on' is not a real meaning of berennen; the only sense is to besiege, which is already listed.
Beschenken means to give a gift to; 'to give a drink' is not a real meaning and the example is nonsense, so it is dropped as a bogus duplicate of the bestow sense.
Bevliegen as 'to fly upon' is not a real modern Dutch meaning; the example is unnatural and it is obscure (the only real sense is covering in animal mating, or flying over/to).
It is practically the same meaning as the principle of confessional secrecy and is rare, so it is a duplicate.
Archaic place name on an obscure word that would only confuse a learner.
'Additional' is not a noun meaning of bijwoning; the word means attendance or cohabitation, which are already listed.
The gloss is a bad definition and duplicates the other meaning 'inland navigation', so this entry adds nothing.
Same meaning as item 1 (a Burman); duplicate.
Duplicates the Birmaan meaning of a Burman person, listed already.
Rascal and child are the same informal sense of blaag (a brat/kid), so this duplicates the other meaning.
Rare sense 'something blue' is essentially a repeat of 'blueness' and only confuses a learner.
Duplicates the other boerenstiel meaning, which is the farmer's trade.
This archaic sense (rebuke) is obscure and would only confuse a learner, while the other meaning (buckling) covers the common use.
It duplicates the other bolderik meaning, which refers to the same plant.
A bolide in Dutch is a fast racing car, so the bare 'bolide' gloss duplicates the other meaning and is not useful.
Boombast means the inner bark (bast), not plain bark, so this duplicates the other meaning "tree bast".
Overly specific species duplicate of the general meaning 'treecreeper'.
Salon table is a wrong meaning and duplicates the corrected drinks-table sense.
Breastwork and parapet are the same meaning, so this duplicates item 4, which is kept as the clearer gloss.
Hip is not a meaning of bottel; the 'hip' sense belongs to 'bot' (bone), so this is a wrong meaning.
Archaic ship provision room is obscure and only confuses a learner.
Bovenwereld as 'law-abiding community' is the opposite of onderwereld and is a rare sense, and this entry is redundant with the better-known 'upper world/heaven' sense.
The 'social meeting' sense is essentially the barbecue event itself, so it duplicates meaning 1.
The botanical name duplicates meaning 1, which already covers the nux vomica seed and plant.
Duplicates the literal meaning of fire's origin; keep the other entry for the figurative hotbed sense.
Breeduit meaning 'widely' is near-identical to the other entry 'extensively', so this duplicates it (e.g., 'breeduit lachen' fits 'widely' but the pair is redundant).
The gloss is just 'one' and the only other sense, coward, is already listed in item 3, so this is a duplicate.
'Disconnected' is not a real meaning of brokkelig (that sense belongs to 'brokkelig' only figuratively as fragmentary at most) and it is better covered by the crumbly sense.
It duplicates item 1 with the same meaning.
It largely repeats item 4, since a bruinhemd is an SA member, and the generic 'Nazi' gloss is imprecise.
'Pests' is not a meaning of bucht; it is a doubtful meaning and overlaps with the junk/disgusting senses.
The gloss 'external' is a bad, non-noun gloss and the real meaning (orthodontic headgear) is listed separately.
'Tawdry' is not a meaning of buitenissig, which means unusual or extravagant, and that is already listed as another meaning.
'Any outsiders' is an archaic and obscure sense that only confuses learners; the article 'de' is correct for the plural buitenlui.
Obscure sense of 'guard duty outside' that largely overlaps with the 'outside guard' meaning, so it only duplicates it and confuses learners.
'Having to stay outside' is a vague, obscure sense that duplicates the outside guard sense; the main meaning 'outsiders' remains listed.
'Wide bonnet' is an obscure archaic sense that only confuses a learner, while the carriage meaning is the one in use.

column3: to accept into the canon of saints
column4: This is just a longer paraphrase of 'to canonise', which is already listed as meaning 2.
Captatie means collecting or soliciting (e.g. donations or favour), not video capture, which is a different word, so this meaning is wrong and obscure.
Carbonzuur means carboxylic acid, not carboxyl group, and that meaning is already listed as the other entry.
'Remarkable' is not a real meaning of casueel (archaic, means incidental), so this entry is wrong and the other covers it.
Archaic weight unit that duplicates the other centenaar sense (100 pounds) and only confuses learners.
A chuppah is the canopy, not the ceremony itself, so this meaning is a loose duplicate of item 1.
Chrestomathy is just the English cognate of the same meaning as anthology, so it duplicates item 3.
Chromatism is essentially the same sense as chromatics (colouring) and is obscure, so it duplicates the other meaning.
